inputs.original_text: This is the usual class-war framing: blame “the wealthy” for every political problem while offering no evidence that money alone determines who is heard inside the APC. Ahead of the 2027 elections, what matters is orderly, accountable leadership and candidates answerable to voters—not rhetoric that turns party disagreements into an attack on the whole system. Broad participation has value, but it must strengthen responsible institutions, not undermine them.
inputs.modified_text: Ahead of the 2027 elections, the priority should be responsible leadership, party unity and candidates who answer to voters—not class-war slogans that treat wealth as proof of wrongdoing. Disagreements within the APC should be handled through accountable institutions, not used to discredit the system itself. Broad participation matters when it reinforces order and responsibility, not when it becomes a pretext for weakening them.
